🚨 충청북도의 맑은 오후, 순찰 중이던 경찰관이 사거리에서 신호를 기다리다 신호를 어기고 지나가는 오토바이 한 대를 발견합니다.
경찰이 멈추라고 했지만 오토바이는 그대로 달아나기 시작하고, 잠시 멈춰 서며 도주를 포기하는 듯하더니 곧바로 중앙선을 넘어 역주행하며 다시 달아납니다.
사이렌을 울리며 뒤쫓는 경찰. 정차 명령을 무시한 오토바이는 차선과 중앙선을 넘나들며 아찔한 도주를 이어 갑니다.
바로 그때, 사이렌 소리를 듣고 근처를 순찰하던 경찰 싸이카가 합류합니다. 진로를 막으려 달려가는 싸이카 앞에서 오토바이는 그제야 멈춰 섰습니다.
운전자는 난폭운전 혐의로 입건됐고, 벌점으로 면허가 정지될 예정입니다.
참고로 신호위반과 중앙선 침범처럼 정해진 위반을 둘 이상 연달아 하며 위험을 일으키면 난폭운전이 되고, 1년 이하 징역이나 500만 원 이하 벌금을 받을 수 있습니다(도로교통법 제46조의3·제151조의2).

"Baby sharks in the swimming pool?" 🦈😂 Leo and his family visit a fun water park and aquarium. While Leo enjoys blowing colorful bubbles, some funny little sharks suddenly appear in the water! Leo gets scared, but his family starts laughing. Then Leo comes up with a hilarious surprise of his own!

Learn useful English words and simple phrases about family, swimming, sea animals, funny surprises, and everyday conversations!

🏊 Simple English sentences about swimming and having fun  
😂 Expressions for surprise, fear, excitement, and laughter  
🗣️ Common English words and phrases for everyday family conversations  
💛 How to talk about fun family adventures and funny moments  
💬 Action phrases like "Look! A shark!", "I'm scared!", "Don't worry!", and "It's so funny!"  
🌊 Simple English sentences for beginners

Watch until the end to discover Leo's hilarious shark surprise! Can Leo scare his family back? And who will laugh the loudest? 🦈😂💛

snippet.title: Reducing worker exposure to traffic in BC work zones starts long before a cone hits the pavement.
snippet.description:
Reducing worker exposure to traffic in BC work zones starts long before a cone hits the pavement.

Here's how this works: every work zone has a buffer zone, the physical space between moving traffic and your crew. WorkSafeBC regulations require that this space be designed into the Traffic Management Plan, not improvised on site. The wider and better-positioned that buffer, the more reaction time both drivers and workers get.

Think of it this way. Exposure isn't just about proximity to vehicles, it's about how long a worker stays in a risk zone and how predictable that risk is. A flagger standing in a clearly marked, well-lit position for a short, defined task has far less exposure than a crew working without proper lane closure sequencing.

Three practices lower exposure the most. First, proper lane closure sequencing so workers never cross active lanes unnecessarily. Second, positive separation using barriers or channelization devices wherever volumes and speeds allow. Third, rotating flagger positions to limit continuous time facing traffic.

Notice how visibility ties into all of this. High-visibility apparel, consistent signage, and advance warning signs give drivers the time they need to adjust behavior before reaching the work zone.

In Vancouver, where traffic volumes and lane widths vary block by block, this planning work matters even more. Crews trained through BCCSA certification bring that awareness to every setup.

Want help designing a work zone that keeps your crew further from traffic? Contact LaneGuard Traffic Control at 778-558-4998.

snippet.title: Diikuti Sampai Dekat Rumah? Jangan Langsung Buka Pagar, Berhenti Dulu!! #informatif #faktaunik
snippet.description:
Saat merasa diikuti sampai dekat rumah, langsung membuka pagar justru berbahaya. Selama sibuk membuka gembok, orang yang mengikuti bisa ikut masuk sebelum pagar tertutup. Kalaupun pagar sempat dikunci, rumah kita tetap sudah ketahuan. Cara memastikannya adalah berhenti sebelum sampai di rumah, lalu membiarkan orang di belakang lewat lebih dulu. Orang yang hanya kebetulan lewat tidak punya alasan untuk ikut berhenti. Kalau orang itu ikut berhenti dan menunggu, itu bukan lagi kebetulan. Jangan membuka pagar, pergilah ke tempat yang ramai seperti pos ronda, minimarket, atau rumah tetangga yang lampunya masih menyala.

Berhentilah di tempat yang terang dan masih terlihat orang, bukan di gang yang gelap. Siapkan kunci sejak jauh dari rumah supaya tidak lama berdiri di depan pagar. Layanan polisi 110 bisa dihubungi gratis selama 24 jam. Cara ini membantu memastikan dan memberi waktu untuk mencari pertolongan, bukan jaminan pasti selamat.

Sumber:
Peel Regional Police (Kanada), Personal Safety ("Do not drive/walk home as you do not want this person to know where you live")
Westchester County Office for Women (Amerika Serikat), Awareness and Prevention Tips ("Always have your key in hand upon returning home so you can open your door immediately" dan "If you think you are being followed, never drive home or pull over in a deserted area.")
RCMP (Kanada), Be street smart ("If you believe you are being followed: Cross the street, go to the nearest group of people or business, and call the police.")
Police Service of Northern Ireland, Protect yourself outdoors (memastikan diikuti dengan mengubah gerak, misalnya menyeberang lebih dari sekali)
SafeWise (perusahaan keamanan, 2023), What to do if you think you are being followed ("stop to look at a store window or tie your shoes" dan "If a potential stalker mimics your maneuver, your suspicions may be warranted.")
Polri, layanan 110 (gratis, 24 jam)

snippet.title: Moon Phase Today November 24th 2026
snippet.description:
It's here! The Beaver Full Moon has arrived, and it's a Supermoon! Bigger and brighter than usual. Subscribe and follow along at Moon Phase dot Today!

So why Beaver Moon? In November, beavers finish building their dams and stock up for winter before the water freezes. That's where the name comes from!

WHAT'S EXPECTED:
Tonight: Beaver Full Moon — 100% illuminated, full Supermoon
Bigger + brighter than a normal full moon
Up most of the night

WHY BEAVER MOON:
November is when beavers finish their dams and stock up for winter
Historically, trappers also set their beaver traps then before the water froze
That's how November's full moon got its name

HOW TO SEE IT:
Look east after sunset — it'll be huge as it rises, then bright and high all night. Best views are just after moonrise and just before moonset when it looks biggest near the horizon.

snippet.title: The Rocket Engine NASA Bombed On Purpose
snippet.description:
A controlled explosion became the test that saved the Moon rocket's engine.

Combustion instability could destroy the F-1 in milliseconds. Engineers deliberately triggered it with a small charge, then refined injector baffles until the engine recovered quickly. Five F-1s powered each Saturn V Moon launch.

Sources: NASA, Solving Combustion Instability and Saving America's First Trips to the Moon (2019), https://www.nasa.gov/history/solving-combustion-instability-and-saving-americas-first-trips-to-the-moon/ ; Aircraft Engine Historical Society, U.S. Manned Rocket Propulsion Evolution, part 8.11, https://www.enginehistory.org/Rockets/RPE08.11/RPE08.11.shtml ; Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum, A New View of the Rocketdyne F-1 Engine (2022), https://airandspace.si.edu/stories/editorial/new-view-rocketdyne-f-1-engine

snippet.description: El 30 de diciembre de 1952, un autobús de dos pisos de la línea 78 cruzaba el Puente de la Torre de Londres cuando la calzada empezó a abrirse bajo sus ruedas. El semáforo seguía en verde y la campana del vigilante no sonó. El conductor, Albert Gunter, pensó que si frenaba acabarían todos en el Támesis, así que aceleró: siete toneladas y media de autobús saltaron un hueco de casi un metro y cayeron sobre la otra mitad. Hubo heridos leves, pero nadie murió. Su recompensa: 10 libras y un día libre.

snippet.description:

Selon les services locaux de secours, plus de 50 personnes ont été examinées, dont certaines avec des "symptômes oculaires et respiratoires", tandis qu'une opération de "décontamination" a été réalisée dans la salle. La responsable de l'intervention au sein de la police du Grand Manchester, Steph Parker, a indiqué qu'une personne avait été hospitalisée.

snippet.description:

Etrafta dolaşırken haritanın en üstündeki adayı merak edip araştırmaya gittim ve adımımı atar atmaz bir iğneyle vurulup bayıltıldım. Ardından kalktığımdaysa boynumda aynı Testere filmlerinden çıkmış patlayıcı tasmayla uyandım ve televizyondaki figür 'Eğer hayatta kalmak istiyorsan av değil, avcı olmalısın.' dedikten sonra kapılar açıldı ve geri sayım başladı. Hemen ortaya koşup bir tabanca aldım ve peşime av köpeği olan aşırı zırhlı biri takıldı. Ben de hemen kaçıp daha fazla mermi ve bir tüfek buldum. Köpeği indirdikten sonra avcının yaklaşmasını bekleyip pusuya düşürmek istedim ama gece görüş gözlüğü olduğu için beni gördü ve az daha ölüyordum. Zar zor da olsa avcıyı da indirmeyi başardım ve kullandığı efsanevi keskin nişancı tüfeğini (sniper'ını) aldım. Sonrasında sahildeki kulübeden eşyalarımı aldım ve ödül olarak 10 bin kripto ve 15 bin dolar kazandım.
